g.text: WLD 205 DAY 5 — PRINT vs. WPS/SWPS WORKSHEET
Use Bridge Print B and the instructor-provided approved procedure example.
Rule: write only what the controlling source actually states. If it is missing or unclear, mark STOP / CHECK.
PART A — BRIDGE PRINT B
2. Joint type at vertical plate / base plate intersection: _________________________
3. Drawing note that sends you to another source: ________________________________
PART B — WHICH SOURCE CONTROLS?
For each item, mark PRINT, APPROVED WPS/SWPS, or STOP / CHECK.
Joint / weld location shown __________________
Assigned process / procedure variables ________
A weld size that is not shown anywhere ________
Drawing note / project instruction _____________
PART C — SOURCE TRACE
Write one requirement from the print:
Write one requirement from the approved procedure example:
What would make you stop and ask the instructor before welding?
EXIT RULE
IDENTIFY → FIND THE SOURCE → READ WHAT IS SPECIFIED → STOP IF INFORMATION IS MISSING
Do not invent weld size, machine settings, preheat/interpass, acceptance criteria, or symbol meaning.
Original PCCC/LTG bridge worksheet. Authorized classroom references and approved procedures remain controlling.
